items.title: GitHub release: anthropics/claude-code v2.1.288
items.what_happened: ## What's changed - Added `$.ui.selection()` for mods: returns the text you last selected in fullscreen mode and, when the selection lies within one transcript row, that row - Added a built-in `gh api` to cloud sessions whose image has no GitHub CLI, and fixed the built-in sending control characters from file names, jq filters or GitHub errors to the terminal - Added recovery for a prompt cleared with Ctrl+C: pressin
